siteTrends.summary: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Tetsu Kariya's Oishinbo manga, titled Shin Oishinbo, announced a supporting pair of cast on Thursday. The anime is scheduled to premiere in 2027. Voice actors Kenji Yamauchi (Toujima Tanzaburou wa Kamen Rider ni Naritai) and Ken Uo (Nazotoki wa Dinner no Ato de) are joining the anime as Mantarou Kyougoku and Toujin Touyama, respectively. Kenichi Nishida (Sayounara Ryuusei, Konnichiwa Jinsei) is directing the anime at SynergySP and Vega Entertainment. Takahiro Nagano (Tensei shitara Ken deshita) is handling the series composition, while Nozomi Kawashige (Deatte 5-byou de Battle) is designing the characters. Kariya began writing Oishinbo in Shogakukan's Big Comic Spirits magazine in 1983, featuring art by Akira Hanasaki. Shogakukan published the 111th and latest volume in December 2014. The manga has been on hiatus since May 2014.
